luiskr.com / experiments/docs/arch-scene / mountArchSceneThree

function mountArchSceneThree(canvas, roots, onPick, onLost?): ArchSceneHandle | null

Defined in: experiments/docs/arch-scene.ts:311

The three.js/WebGL arm of the architecture scene — the original renderer, kept as the synchronous fallback for every device without WebGPU (and the ?debug=webGLMode:fallback probe). Returns null when no GL context can be acquired; the composite then reports onLost.

Parameters

canvas

HTMLCanvasElement

Target canvas.

roots

object[]

Manifest root buckets.

onPick

(_path) => void

Called with the manifest path on a node pick.

onLost?

() => void

Called when the WebGL context is lost mid-flight.

Returns

ArchSceneHandle | null

The scene handle, or null when no GL context exists.
